tooltip.asobibatweaks.atlas.insert: Right-click with a filled map in the other hand to insert it

message.asobibatweaks.atlas.duplicate: That map is already in this atlas
gamerule.asobibaDailyPlayTimeEnabled.des: Opt in for this world only. Counts each player's cumulative real play time per calendar date; reaching the cap disconnects them until the next reset. Skipped dates do not increase played days. Default: OFF.
gamerule.asobibaDailyPlayTimeLimitMinute: Allowed real play time per player per date, 1–1440 minutes. Default: 120. Offline time and paused singleplayer time do not count; multiplayer menus do.
gamerule.asobibaDailyPlayTimeResetUtcOff: Reset at midnight at this fixed UTC offset, in minutes (−840 to 840). Default: 540, Japan UTC+09:00. Fixed offset only; no daylight-saving changes.
asobibatweaks.play_time.limit_reached: Daily play-time limit reached. You can play again after %s.
